competitors.name: Amazon / Whole Foods Market
competitors.action: Supermarket News reported Amazon now offers same-day perishables delivery in 2,300 U.S. cities. Amazon said monthly active perishable customers are up 50% since the start of the year, same-day orders with perishables average three times more units per order, and perishables now account for six of Amazon.com's 20 top-selling items.

competitors.name: Ahold Delhaize USA / Pear Commerce
competitors.action: Grocery Dive reported Ahold Delhaize USA partnered with Pear Commerce so shoppers can add products to ADUSA digital carts from non-ADUSA websites, including CPG recipe pages, brand product pages and store locator tools. The integration is available across all five ADUSA U.S. banners and gives AD Retail Media another path to connect content exposure to cart action.

competitors.name: Publix / GreenWise
competitors.action: Supermarket News reported Publix expanded its GreenWise frozen fruit recall to all GreenWise Organic Whole Blueberries and Whole Mixed Berries after FDA linked frozen blueberries to a multistate E. coli outbreak. The recall covers eight southeastern states, with 12 illnesses and four hospitalizations reported.

trends.topic: Grocery discovery and fulfillment are moving closer to immediate cart conversion
trends.magnitude: Amazon same-day perishables in 2,300 cities; ADUSA click-to-cart integration across five banners
trends.context: Retailers are reducing friction between product inspiration, basket building and rapid fulfillment. Frozen and premium CPG brands need accurate digital content, recipe/cart compatibility and availability discipline, not just shelf placement.

trends.topic: Frozen private-label recall risk remains visible
trends.magnitude: Eight-state Publix GreenWise frozen fruit recall tied to 12 illnesses and four hospitalizations
trends.context: The expanded GreenWise recall is not pizza-specific, but it keeps frozen supply-chain safety and retailer-owned brand risk in the public eye.
